Lich Survivors: the web build and the Anchor port, frame for frame

Both builds stepped tick by tick from the start with the same inputs, captured at the same ticks (the web build in headless Chrome, the port in a hidden Anchor instance). The simulation is identical to 15 digits (state digests over 2 minutes of play, a movement run and the whole ending); what differs in the pictures is GPU arithmetic: dither and sparkle pixels.
